GRAPH_CANONICAL_SCHEMA.note: A1 canonical_records: Workflow/Subject/Execution/Completion/Decision/FollowupEdge (ParentChildEdge alias); executor-neutral logical records, no storage engine

SUBJECT_IDENTITY_RULE.note: deterministic or minted derivation; SUBJECT_ID_IS_AUTHORITY=no; ID never reused; collision fails closed

GRAPH_BOOTSTRAP_STRATEGY.note: read/normalize/cross-validate/materialize candidate; legacy = input/evidence only; no heuristic merge

GRAPH_CUTOVER_RULE.note: PRE_CUTOVER/CUTOVER/POST_CUTOVER; ONE_CUTOVER_AUTHORITY=yes; failure cannot create dual authority

REVISION_MODEL.note: revision unit = Subject aggregate; Workflow record has independent revision; no whole-graph serialization

CAS_MODEL.note: CAS_CHECK_BEFORE_AUTHORITATIVE_COMMIT=yes; stale mutation fail_closed; bypass only A4 bootstrap/cutover

TRANSACTION_BOUNDARY.note: one Subject aggregate per CAS commit; canonical two-root followup; no whole-graph transaction

IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY_RULE.note: same key+same fingerprint -> recorded outcome, no duplicate semantic effect; mismatch fail_closed; cutover/recovery replay obeys same principle

PROJECTION_REBUILD_RULE.note: rebuild from canonical authority only; STALE_PROJECTION_MAY_BE_REBUILT=yes; rebuild mutates graph=no

CONFLICT_RULE.note: REVISION_CONFLICT / IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT / PREDECESSOR_STATE_CONFLICT / AUTHORITY_STALE / binding conflicts distinct

CONCURRENCY_RULE.note: LOST_UPDATE_ALLOWED=no; SILENT_LAST_WRITE_WINS=no; independent Subjects mutate concurrently; no global lock

AUTHORITY_EVALUATION_MODEL.note: deterministic engine inputs; decision classes ALLOW/DENY/NEEDS_APPROVAL/NEEDS_APPROVAL_BLOCKED; no semantic reasoning

PRINCIPAL_BINDING_RULE.note: principal bound at trusted adapter/runtime boundary; model cannot self-assert; fail-closed without trusted binding

TRUSTED_CONTEXT_AUTHORITY_RULE.note: trusted resource implies no mutation authority; principal-bound before trusted resolution; lease-scoped for mutation

SUBJECT_BINDING_RULE.note: SUBJECT_BINDING_ZERO_ONE_MANY frozen; deterministic validity filter first; automation rule; heuristics denied

MECHANICAL_RECOVERY_BOUNDARY.note: recovery = bounded deterministic read-then-repair; may/may_not lists; never semantic reasoning; never triggers cutover

canonical_subject_model.plan_subject_consistent_with_a1: PLAN_IS_SINGLE_AGGREGATE=yes; milestone is Plan-internal structural reference, not a Subject kind; PlanSubject identity stable across revisions

typed_authority_roots: Workflow aggregate only where an actual Workflow metadata mutation contract applies

principal_lease_model.semantic_boundary: A lease never contains semantic planning decisions; no Plan/Work Item/SPEC/Profile Task semantics inside the lease; the lease is mechanical evidence only.

record_revision_authority.record_ref_resolution: record_ref -> owning Subject -> owning Subject revision
record_revision_authority.WORKFLOW_METADATA_MUTATION_REVISION_ROOT: Workflow record only where its metadata mutation contract applies

revision_representation.revision_type: an opaque content-derived revision_token paired with a monotonic revision_number per aggregate; this is the canonical storage-independent revision type - no database, storage engine, or serialization format is selected (NO_STORAGE_ENGINE_FROZEN=yes)
revision_representation.aggregate_id: canonical Subject internal ID (minted or deterministic per A1 subject_identity_rule); the revision unit is identified by the Subject aggregate, never by executor, session, path, or pointer
revision_representation.revision_number: monotonically increasing integer >= 1 within the aggregate, never reused, no gaps required; the initial revision of any Subject is revision_number 1 (child Subjects start at their own independent revision 1)
revision_representation.revision_token: opaque content-derived token: deterministic hash over the aggregate's committed record set plus the previous revision_token (chain) or the initial token for revision 1
revision_representation.storage_independent: the representation is defined by the contract, not by any storage engine: any storage mapping must expose exactly this canonical revision unit, counter and token; NO_STORAGE_ENGINE_FROZEN=yes
revision_representation.ordering_semantics: revision_number strictly increases on every committed mutation; revision_token changes if and only if the committed record set changed; equal token implies identical committed record set
revision_representation.no_choreography: the model defines the revision contract but does not choreograph revision: no lock manager, no revision coordinator, no storage-specific revision table is defined by M3-A3

revision_cas_model.authoritative_read_source: durable authoritative record set only; Event Log/git/pointers/projections never CAS sources

idempotency_model.same_key_same_payload: returns recorded outcome; no new semantic effect

key_binding.idempotency_key_binding: principal/authority context + operation (contract identity) + typed target (object_kind + object_id + expected revision context) + semantic fingerprint
key_binding.semantic_fingerprint: deterministic digest of the semantic payload of the request (for followup: the source Decision reference + statement + target references; for transitions: the requested transition + evidence references)
key_binding.key_rule: the key binds actor and operation and target so that a different principal, different operation, or different target can never consume the same dedupe slot

idempotency_model.source: A3 idempotency_model + A5 idempotent_recovery + A45 idempotency_cross_contract

bootstrap_migration_model.ambiguous_migration: NEEDS_SEMANTIC_CHOICE or UNMIGRATABLE (explicit, bounded); never heuristic reconstruction
bootstrap_migration_model.bootstrap_strategy: A future bootstrap is a read, normalize, cross-validate, and materialize-candidate procedure. It processes source classes in dependency order Workspace -> Project -> Plan, then considers legacy lifecycle evidence only when an explicit canonical record mapping is complete. No source class is authoritative merely because A0 labels it AUTHORITATIVE_BOOTSTRAP_INPUT_CANDIDATE. Candidate facts are accepted only after every candidate validation gate passes; unresolved facts remain evidence or quarantine and do not become graph records.

cutover_model.POST_CUTOVER_AUTHORITY: Durable Subject Graph is the sole lifecycle authority
cutover_model.cutover_rule: A validated graph candidate plus all cutover preconditions plus one explicit authorized cutover transaction causes one one-way authority transition. Before the atomic authority flip, legacy operational authority remains sole. After a committed flip, the Durable Subject Graph is the sole lifecycle authority and all legacy state is history, shadow, or derived compatibility projection evidence only.

binding_model.ZERO: no valid candidate remains after the deterministic validity filter
binding_model.ONE: automatic binding only if exactly one deterministic valid candidate AND materialized Decision AND valid authority AND valid revision AND valid predecessor
binding_model.SUBJECT_BINDING_AUTOMATION_RULE: automatic binding/recovery iff candidate_count==1 AND candidate semantic decision durably materialized AND required authority valid AND required revision/predecessor valid. Otherwise NEEDS_SEMANTIC_CHOICE or a bounded deterministic not-found/conflict. HEURISTIC_SUBJECT_SELECTION_ALLOWED=no.
